license_or_terms: Synthetic data generated for this project; free to use and redistribute. No real customer data.

generation.method: Month-by-month simulation with latent risk index, logistic hazards, stage-conditional historical collection policy and capped recoveries. Parameters in generation_parameters.json.

transformation_history: data-quality gate (critical failures block loading and training)
load SQLite in one transaction (delete + insert, idempotent)
known_limitations: All records are synthetic; no PUBLIC observations are present.
Collection-event outcomes are simulated and are not evidence of real-world collection effectiveness.
Historical collection actions were assigned at random within delinquency stage; real-world action assignment is usually non-random (confounded).
Payment timing within a month is not simulated; each month has at most one collection event per account and the month's cash is attributed to it.
Macro stress and seasonality are stylised assumptions.
